name: Doki Doki Easter Hunt!
source:
Do you want to go on a cute easter hunt? Do you want to go on a cute easter hunt with the dokis? This is just the mod for you: Doki Doki Easter Hunt! A short but fun mod with a twist ending. So what does it entail, you ask? Play and find out!

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/easter-hunt]DokiMods[/url]]
